description: Black to kill the L-shaped white group in the bottom-right. Reduce a liberty, force the extension, then capture.

J3.comment: Atari from the right. White is forced to extend.

J4.comment: Doesn't take a liberty. White lives by playing G4.

H3.comment: Atari from above. White is forced to extend.

H4.comment: Doesn't take a liberty. White lives by extending again at J4.

F3.comment: Doesn't reduce a liberty. White extends at J3 and gets two liberties - the kill becomes much harder.
